verdict.rationale: Navan's own materials claim "seamless integrations with most ERPs", and its API exposes accounting preferences and ERP settings, so a first-party ERP sync capability exists. Nothing names QuickBooks, NetSuite, or Xero, and nothing documents user-controlled GL account, class, or department mapping. missing for 10: named QuickBooks/NetSuite/Xero connectors, documented GL account/class/department mapping controls, transaction export/sync behavior details, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a finance lead, transactions sync to QuickBooks, NetSuite, or Xero with GL account, class, and department mappings I control

citations.quote: Query accounting preferences and ERP settings config changes
